# ArmArk
[Git Source](https://github.com/OasisDEX/summer-earn-protocol/blob/main/packages/core-contracts/src/contracts/arks/ArmArk.sol)

**Inherits:**
[ArkWithWithdrawalRequest](../ark-with-withdrawal-request.md)

**Title:**
ArmArk

Ark contract for managing ETH deposits into Origin ARM via the ARM contract

Implements strategy for depositing ETH through the ARM contract, withdrawing ARM LP shares, and tracking yield


## State Variables
### arm
The ARM contract this Ark interacts with


```solidity
IArm public immutable arm
```


### weth
The WETH contract


```solidity
IWETH public immutable weth
```


### withdrawalRequestId
The request ID for the withdrawal


```solidity
uint256 public withdrawalRequestId
```


## Functions
### constructor

Constructor to set up the ArmArk


```solidity
constructor(address _arm, ArkParams memory _params) ArkWithWithdrawalRequest(_params, 15);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`_arm`|`address`|Address of the ARM contract|
|`_params`|`ArkParams`|ArkParams struct containing necessary parameters for Ark initialization|


### totalAssets

Returns the total assets managed by this Ark in the ARM protocol


```solidity
function totalAssets() public view override(Ark, IArk) returns (uint256 assets);
```
**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`assets`|`uint256`|The total balance of underlying assets held in the vault for this Ark, including any pending withdrawal amounts|


### assetsInWithdrawalQueue

Returns the assets in the withdrawal queue.


```solidity
function assetsInWithdrawalQueue() public view returns (uint256);
```
**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`<none>`|`uint256`|assets The amount of underlying assets currently pending withdrawal.|


### withdrawUsingSwap

Withdraws assets from the Ark using a swap

This function is only callable by the keeper


```solidity
function withdrawUsingSwap(uint256 amount, bytes calldata data) external onlyKeeper nonReentrant;
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`amount`|`uint256`|The amount of assets to withdraw|
|`data`|`bytes`|The data to pass to the swap (router and swap calldata)|


### requestWithdrawal

Requests a withdrawal of underlying assets from the Ark.

This function is only callable by the keeper.


```solidity
function requestWithdrawal(uint256 amount) external onlyKeeper;
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`amount`|`uint256`|The amount of underlying asset to request a withdrawal for.|


### claimWithdrawal

Claims a previously requested ARM redemption

Reverts if no withdrawal is outstanding, otherwise calls
arm.claimRedeem(withdrawalRequestId) (which returns WETH, so no
wrapping is needed) and clears the stored request id.


```solidity
function claimWithdrawal() external onlyKeeper;
```

### isWithdrawalClaimRequired

Checks if withdrawal claim is required

Returns true if there's an active withdrawal request that hasn't been claimed yet


```solidity
function isWithdrawalClaimRequired() public view returns (bool);
```

### _withdrawableTotalAssets

Internal function to get the total assets that are withdrawable

Returns the sum of the direct asset balance


```solidity
function _withdrawableTotalAssets() internal view override returns (uint256 withdrawableAssets);
```
**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`withdrawableAssets`|`uint256`|Assets that can be immediately withdrawn by users or rebalanced|


### _board

Deposits assets into the ARM protocol via the ARM contract


```solidity
function _board(uint256 amount, bytes calldata) internal override;
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`amount`|`uint256`|The amount of assets to deposit|
|`<none>`|`bytes`||


### _disembark

No-op disembark hook

Direct synchronous disembark is not supported: exits from the ARM
position go through requestWithdrawal/claimWithdrawal or
withdrawUsingSwap. Only WETH already held directly is immediately
withdrawable (see _withdrawableTotalAssets).


```solidity
function _disembark(uint256 amount, bytes calldata) internal override;
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`amount`|`uint256`|The amount of assets to withdraw (unused)|
|`<none>`|`bytes`||


### _harvest

Internal function for harvesting rewards

ARM auto-compounds rewards, so this is a no-op


```solidity
function _harvest(bytes calldata)
    internal
    pure
    override
    returns (address[] memory rewardTokens, uint256[] memory rewardAmounts);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`<none>`|`bytes`||

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`rewardTokens`|`address[]`|The addresses of the reward tokens (empty array in this case)|
|`rewardAmounts`|`uint256[]`|The amounts of the reward tokens (empty array in this case)|
